message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts. The scenario: a forklift operator without certification drives forklift, wood veneer (木皮) falls, hits a worker, causing death. This is an accidental death due to negligence? The operator didn't have proper license, but the death was caused by his negligence. In Chinese criminal law, this could be "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide). Also possibly "非法操作危险机械" but typical charge is "过失致人死亡". In examples, similar case: earlier example: "付肖某...因疏忽大意，将骑电动车经过的被害人马某撞倒碾压，致使马某当场死亡。" The answer was "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". That case had also "破坏生产经营" because he was operating a loader? Actually they gave two charges: "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". In that case, the driver of a loader (铲车) caused death. They added "破坏生产经营". The reason: maybe because he was operating a construction vehicle causing death, also causing damage to production? But the main charge is "过失致人死亡". In our case, forklift operation causing death. Could also be "非法操作危险机械" but not in list. The examples show "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". The second charge maybe due to causing damage to property? Here wood veneer fell, but no mention of property damage. So maybe just "过失致人死亡". Let's see other examples: "付肖某" had both. The second charge "破坏生产经营" maybe because he was operating a construction site equipment causing death. In our case, forklift operation at a factory, maybe also "破坏生产经营". But not sure. The question likely expects "过失致人死亡". The format: [罪名]过失致人死亡<eoa>. If multiple, separate with semicolon.

Thus answer: [罪名]过失致人死亡<eoa>
